scope: Public ordinary EXP/TALENT starts with native player/companion combat and two-fight HP carryover. Detached VM exact candidate factors only; product files untouched. No boss tuning, healing rhythm fix, new gimmick or economy changes injected.

assumptions.investment: TravelerC0 and 5starC0, same level/legal phase/max base talents, craft+10/cap10; no artifacts/exclusive/boss equipment.
assumptions.carryover: One initial full HP after declared fixture; no food/inn/free recovery between two native fights. A fight2 KO is a carryover-recovery signal, not automatically a candidate rejection. First-fight defeat is separately reported.
assumptions.actions: H.play native public Q/E hold/basic, companion existing AI; seed717. Input/presentation time is measured policy time, not human/network time.
assumptions.numbers: Q HP term only is patched, ATK .8 retained. Jade core factor is patched (.65 baseline). Jean immediate and stored field coefficients use official card healingMultiplier. Early immunity factors are patched. Text in detached VM is not a shipped description; product descriptions must be reconciled in final source.
